blocks.text: RIYADH, Saudi Arabia — Saudi Arabia said on Saturday that it had intercepted a fresh wave of incoming drones, as its ally Egypt weighed sending the kingdom help in defending against repeated attacks from Yemen’s Houthis. Riyadh leads a military coalition supporting Yemen’s internationally recognized government in its war with the Houthis, and a military spokesman for the Iran-backed group said Saturday that dozens of Saudi strikes over the past day had killed and wounded “numerous” people. Since Yemen’s conflict flared back to life in July after a years-long hiatus, Saudi Arabia has faced sustained Houthi missile and drone attacks targeting […]...
